decision_conditions:
Condition : 2 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 1st September 2006, the demolition of the existing and the erection of a single storey rear extension was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 
Condition : 3 - Informative
The existing single storey rear extension is unlawful in its current form and as a result your client may be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is likely also to make the property difficult to sell.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for demolition of the existing and erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
